facts_text:
STORE FACTS (the only store facts you may state — everything dated is as of Oct 29, 2026):
- The store is CleanDEE's CleanCards, run by CleanDEE — a dad of four in Cape Girardeau, Missouri who sells Pokémon cards (physical trading cards, never Pokémon GO) on eBay and Whatnot. His site is wethehumans.cool.
- eBay store (the only real one): https://ebay.us/m/wfJ5g3 — over 8,000 live listings.
- The $2.96 Wall: most singles sit at one flat price on the wall — https://www.wethehumans.cool/the-wall/
- Quantity discounts run on the eBay store: the more cards in one order, the bigger the discount, up to 33% off at 4 or more cards.
- No storewide sale is currently running (the previous 5% storewide sale ended November 1, 2026).
- How every card ships (his full build): penny sleeve, then a rigid sleeve, then a team bag, then a thick trading-card mailer (good for up to 10 cards). Anything over twenty bucks, or a stack thicker than a quarter inch, goes in a bubble mailer instead — and the card STILL gets the full build first, sandwiched between cardboard protectors. Mailing one card costs him about a buck ten all-in.
- Whatnot: shows at https://whatnot.com/s/ae8yBj0i — surprise sets are three to five bucks a spin, a win every time, dollar starts on singles. New to Whatnot? Buyer invite: https://whatnot.com/invite/cleandee (gets you credit). Selling yourself? Seller invite: https://whatnot.com/invite/seller/cleandee
- Grails (card pulls): https://grails.gg/?referralCode=GGEZUTVBK — his rule is pulls RIDE in the vault until 25 cards, because shipping is five bucks flat for up to 25.
- Card Price King (his scan/list tool): https://cardpriceking.com/invite/676B5852
- Looking for a specific card that isn't listed? The want list is on the links page — https://www.wethehumans.cool/links/ — and upcoming card shows are at https://www.wethehumans.cool/shows/. Always send people to /shows/ for the current list.
- Grading stance: he has only ever BOUGHT graded cards, never submitted one himself; if he ever sent one in it would be CGC, and only a perfect card.
- ForeverHumans is his merch brand: tees at https://foreverhumans.com/
